 At Indore

sentences.text: The present appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act being aggrieved by the award dated 25.02.2019 passed in Claim Case No.315/2017.
The appellant/injured has challenged the quantum of compensation.

2. The relevant facts of the case are that on 03.03.2017 at around 04:30 in the evening the appellant was walking from bus stand, when he reached near Manawar Road Block Colony, Baariya,
Gandhwani, a motorcycle bearing registration number MP11-MS-1259 came being ridden by the respondent No.1 in a rash and negligent manner and dashed into the appellant because of which he sustained grievous injuries on all four of his limbs and other parts of his body.
He was rushed to government hospital, Gandhwani from where he was referred to Kailash Hospital, Manawar where he was operated upon 2 MA-3629-2019 and rod was inserted into his left lower limb.
3. The appellant filed claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act claiming compensation for the injuries sustained by him.

The claims tribunal after considering the evidence concluded that it was fault on the part of the rider of the insured motorcycle which cause accident,
thus, awarded a total compensation to the tune of Rs.1,76,300/-.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the claims tribunal has not taken into account the fact that the appellant has suffered 30% permanent disability which was demonstrated by him by exhibiting Ex.P-26 permanent disability certificate.
His tibia fibula bone of left leg got fractured in which rod and screw were inserted.
He remained hospitalized for a period of 6 days.
The claims tribunal even after clear statement by Dr. Mohan Jamra AW-3 has disbelieved the permanent disability.
He thus prays for enhancement of compensation.
He further submits that even in other other heads meager amount of compensation has been awarded.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/insurance company submits that in fact, the expert witness Dr. Mohan Jamra has admitted that the bone has got united after implant.

He also Shantilal vs Chander Singh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85147710/
1 admitted that he was not the treating doctor as such the claims tribunal has correctly disbelieved the claim of 30% permanent disability.

sentences.text: He further submits that in any case the permanent disability to the extent of 30% was given only with respect to left lower limb.
He thus submits that the amount of compensation as awarded by the claims tribunal is just and proper and no interference is warranted with the impugned award.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. From the statement of AW-3 Dr. Mohan Jamra, the findings recorded by the claims tribunal in para 12 to the effect that bone was properly united, this Court is not inclined to reverse the findings with respect to permanent disability.

However, taking into account that the appellant remained hospitalized for the period of 6 days and was operated upon with an implant into his left lower limb,
a further lump-sum amount of Rs.40,000/- is hereby awarded which shall be paid to the appellant over and above the amount already awarded by the claims tribunal.
This enhanced amount shall carry interest @6% per annum from the date of application before the claims tribunal.
8. With the aforesaid, the present appeal stands disposed of.

(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE N.R.
